subject: Attack-surface QA: SAST/DAST, SBOM, pen-test & patch SLA details
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@heliosinsurance.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@heliosinsurance.com
Date: 2026-09-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor evidence request — SAST/DAST cadence, SBOM and pen-test summary

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement RFP we need a short package covering:
- SAST and DAST tooling and cadence (who runs scans, frequency, triage workflow)
- Patch SLA commitments for critical / high / medium findings across hosted and private deployments
- Executive summary of most recent penetration test (third-party vendor, date, high/critical findings and remediation status)
- SBOM export covering runtime and build-time components (we only need a CSV summary at this stage)

It would help if you can also provide a high-level remediation timeline (weeks to remediate critical vs non-critical). We are trying to close our vendor security review by the end of next week.

Can you confirm what you can deliver and an ETA?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Helios Insurance
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@heliosinsurance.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — SAST/DAST cadence, SBOM and pen-test summary

Elaine —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide the following by tomorrow EOD (attachments + a short walk-through):

1) SAST / DAST
- SAST: we run scheduled SAST scans (static analysis) on all service repositories integrated into CI on every PR and a full repo scan nightly. Tooling: internal orchestration + OSS scanners (results normalized into our findings tracker).
- DAST: authenticated and unauthenticated dynamic scans against staging and pre-prod every 72 hours for high-traffic services, weekly for lower-traffic services; targeted smoke DAST runs before any major release.
- Triage workflow: findings are ingested into our tracking system and assigned an owner within 24 hours; critical findings have a mandatory 24-hour incident triage meeting.

2) Patch SLAs (hosted API / Redwood-managed)
- Critical (RCE / data exfil): remediation plan initiated within 24 hours and mitigation/fix deployed within 72 hours, followed by verification.
- High: remediation plan initiated within 72 hours and deployment within 14 calendar days.
- Medium/Low: prioritization per sprint; typical window 30–90 days depending on impact.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customers control patch cadence; we provide recommended remediation timelines and documented update playbooks and will commit to notification and hotfix delivery windows per the contract.

3) Pen test summary
- Last third-party pentest: Q2 2026 performed by VendorSec (Tom Reynolds). No outstanding criticals; one high finding (improper auth check in internal admin endpoint) was patched and verified within 10 days. We will attach the executive summary PDF (redacted for PII).

4) SBOM
- We will attach a CSV summary of runtime and build-time components (name, version, source, license, risk score). Full SBOMs are available under NDA or delivered through your secure intake.

5) Remediation schedule
- Attached the proposed remediation-schedule-Helios.xlsx with sprint-level estimates for resolving open/likely findings; includes rollback and verification steps.

Attachments: redwood-sbom-summary-20260902.csv, redwood-pt-exec-summary-2026Q2.pdf, remediation-schedule-Helios.xlsx

ETA: packaged attachments + this note today by 17:00 PT. If you want a short walkthrough we can schedule a 30-minute session tomorrow.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Solutions Security
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vendorsec.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Elaine Park <elaine.park@heliosinsurance.com>
Cc: security@heliosinsurance.com
Date: 2026-09-03T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — SAST/DAST cadence, SBOM and pen-test summary

Hi all —

Elaine, quick note from VendorSec: our Q2 2026 engagement with Redwood covered external and authenticated internal endpoints. Scope and approach are documented in the exec summary attached by Karthik. For procurement: we can provide a signed letter of attestation on the pen-test scope and results if needed.

Karthik — can you confirm whether Redwood will allow a scoped re-test within 60 days if Helios requests one as part of acceptance? We often see buyers require re-test commitments for critical/high findings discovered during procurement.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Director, Assessments
VendorSec
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vendorsec.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@heliosinsurance.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence request — SAST/DAST cadence, SBOM and pen-test summary

Tom / Elaine —

Confirming: we support a scoped re-test within 60 days for procurement-related verification. A couple of clarifications:
- The re-test window is available for hosted & dedicated environments managed by Redwood. For private/on-prem installs we will coordinate with the customer's infra team; re-test timing is dependent on customer scheduling.
- For critical CVE remediation we commit to the timelines in the SLA above (24–72 hours for mitigation & fix deployment for Redwood-managed services). We will supply signed attestation from VendorSec for the original assessment on request.

Operational notes:
- All remediation is tracked in JIRA:SEC-4123 (internal) — we will provide a read-only view for Helios if you would like continuous visibility.
- We recommend an initial walkthrough of the SBOM and the remediation schedule; Karthik, Neha and Markus can join. Proposed times: 2026-09-04 09:00 PT or 2026-09-04 13:00 PT.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Solutions Security
Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@heliosinsurance.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@heliosinsurance.com, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vendorsec.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T14:21:00-07:00

Karthik —

Thanks, this is exactly what we needed. We have the attachments and the spreadsheet. Please book the 13:00 PT slot for the walkthrough and include the read-only JIRA access details in the calendar invite. Also, VendorSec, please include the attestation PDF in the shared drive link once available.

Best,
Elaine Park

Helios Insurance
